parameters.query:
INSERT INTO infofee01_rag.if_extraction_log
(
    TextUUIDBin,
    Stage,
    Status,
    Message,
    LoggedAt
)
VALUES
(
    UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1),
    'extract',
    'done',
    $2,
    NOW()
);

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_texts
SET
    TextStatus = 'pending',
    TextFailedReason = NULL
WHERE TextUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1);

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_queue
SET
    Status = 'processing',
    StartedAt = NOW(),
    FinishedAt = NULL,
    Attempts = Attempts + 1,
    LastError = NULL
  
WHERE QueueID =
    {{ $('MySQL - claim one pending row').first().json.QueueID }};

SELECT QueueID, BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(TextUUIDBin) AS TextUUID, Filepath, Attempts

FROM infofee01_rag.if_extraction_queue

WHERE Status = 'pending' 
  AND (StartedAt IS NULL OR StartedAt < (NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)) 

ORDER BY CreatedAt ASC 

LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;

parameters.jsonBody:

  file: $json.PaddleFileBase64,
  fileType: $json.PaddleFileType,

  useLayoutDetection: true,
  useOcrForImageBlock: true,

  useDocOrientationClassify: false,
  useDocUnwarping: false,
  useChartRecognition: false,

  formatBlockContent: true,
  returnMarkdownImages: false
} }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
(
    QueueID,
    TextUUIDBin,
    PartNumber,
    PageFrom,
    PageTo,
    Status,
    Attempts
)
VALUES
(
    $1,
    UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($2),
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    'pending',
    0
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    TextUUIDBin = VALUES(TextUUIDBin),
    PageFrom = VALUES(PageFrom),
    PageTo = VALUES(PageTo);

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_queue
SET
    Status = 'parts_pending',
    StartedAt = NULL,
    FinishedAt = NULL,
    LastError = NULL
WHERE
    QueueID = $1
    AND Status = 'processing';

SELECT
    p.PartID,
    p.QueueID,
    BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(p.TextUUIDBin) AS TextUUID,
    p.PartNumber,
    p.PageFrom,
    p.PageTo,
    p.Attempts,
    q.Filepath
FROM infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts p
INNER JOIN infofee01_rag.if_extraction_queue q
    ON q.QueueID = p.QueueID
WHERE
    p.Status = 'pending'
    AND q.Status = 'parts_pending'
ORDER BY
    q.CreatedAt ASC,
    p.PartNumber ASC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
SET
    Status = 'processing',
    StartedAt = NOW(),
    FinishedAt = NULL,
    Attempts = Attempts + 1,
    LastError = NULL
WHERE
    PartID = $1
    AND Status = 'pending';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
SET
    DoclingJSON = $1,
    DoclingMD = $2,
    PaddleJSON = $3,
    Extractor = $4,
    Status = 'done',
    LastError = NULL,
    FinishedAt = NOW()
WHERE PartID = $5;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS TotalParts,
    SUM(Status = 'done') AS DoneParts,
    SUM(Status = 'pending') AS PendingParts,
    SUM(Status = 'processing') AS ProcessingParts,
    SUM(Status = 'failed') AS FailedParts,
    SUM(Status = 'dead_letter') AS DeadParts
FROM infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
WHERE QueueID = $1;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_queue
SET
    Status = 'dead_letter',
    FinishedAt = NOW(),
    LastError = CONCAT(
        'EXTRACTION_PART_DEAD_LETTER: ',
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
            WHERE QueueID = $1
              AND Status = 'dead_letter'
        ),
        ' part(s) failed permanently'
    )
WHERE QueueID = $1;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_queue
SET
    Status = 'done',
    FinishedAt = NOW(),
    LastError = NULL
WHERE QueueID = $1
  AND Status = 'parts_pending';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
SET
    Status = 'failed',
    LastError = $1,
    FinishedAt = NOW()
WHERE PartID = $2
  AND Status = 'processing';

SELECT
    PartID,
    QueueID,
    Attempts,
    LastError
FROM infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
WHERE PartID = $1;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
SET
    Status = 'pending',
    StartedAt = NULL,
    FinishedAt = NULL,
    LastError = CONCAT(
        'RETRY: ',
        IFNULL(LastError, 'unknown error')
    )
WHERE PartID = $1
  AND Status = 'failed';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
SET
    Status = 'dead_letter',
    FinishedAt = NOW(),
    LastError = CONCAT(
        IFNULL(LastError, 'unknown error'),
        ' | DEAD_LETTER: exceeded 3 attempts'
    )
WHERE PartID = $1
  AND Status = 'failed';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_texts
SET
    TextStatus = 'failed',
    TextFailedReason = 'EXTRACTION_PART_DEAD_LETTER'
WHERE TextUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1);

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts
SET
    Status = 'pending',
    Attempts = GREATEST(Attempts - 1, 0),

    LastError = CONCAT(
        IFNULL(LastError, ''),
        CASE
            WHEN LastError IS NULL OR LastError = ''
                THEN ''
            ELSE ' | '
        END,
        'STALE_PROCESSING_RECOVERY: worker did not finish'
    ),

    StartedAt = NULL,
    FinishedAt = NULL

WHERE Status = 'processing'
  AND StartedAt < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE;

INSERT INTO infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
(
    QueueID,
    TextUUIDBin,
    Status,
    Attempts
)
VALUES
(
    $1,
    UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($2),
    'pending',
    0
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    QueueID = VALUES(QueueID),
    Status = CASE
        WHEN Status IN ('done', 'processing')
            THEN Status
        ELSE 'pending'
    END;
